scope: External verification wrapper idempotency repair; no runtime inputs or metadata regenerated.
cause: Wrapper unconditionally wrote government.rs after CRLF replacement even when zero replacements occurred; unchanged bytes advanced mtime and invalidated Cargo inputs.
fix: Write only when normalized bytes differ; report government_file_written explicitly on future runs.

cases: CRLF normalizes once, second pass retains mtime
read-only canonical path never invokes writer
